description: Create or replace a template. The body is checked before saving: an unclosed {{#each}}/{{#if}} or an unknown block is rejected with its line number. Required: key (short handle, unique per tenant), name, and the source — either body (the HTML WITH placeholders) or body_document_id (an already uploaded .html file, read straight from storage). Prefer body_document_id for anything sizeable: the template never passes through a model that way, so a millimetre-positioned layout cannot be altered in transit. Do not inline images, that is what assets are for. Optional: format (html|docx, default html), description, active. Placeholders: {{variable}} for text, and for an image put its NAME directly after 'base64,' in the src — exactly the shape the existing hand-built process uses. Returns what the template expects.

key.description: Short handle of the template, unique per tenant

name: upsert_document_template
